tara: Heads-up — saw a 95p latency regression in canary after we split prefill/decode and enabled phase-aware scheduling. ~12% tail increase on streaming flows. Anyone else seeing this?

mike: I noticed too earlier this morning. Which model + config?

tara: model: gpt-open-13b-8q, seq=1024. Median fine, tail up. We moved to separate queues + tuned token budgets (prefill=48, decode=8). Also changed kernel-selection tie-breaker to favor smaller-kernel for prefill. Perf-bot posted snapshot.

perf-bot: quick snapshot: kernel-selector spend +18%, KV cache misses x2 on decode phase, decode-queue peak depth ~= 6. Flame snippet: 
```
kernel_selector: 18.3%\nkv_cache: 12.7% (misses doubled)\nruntime_dispatch: 9.1%\n```

anita: KV misses x2 is the red flag. When we favored smaller kernels for prefill we may have shifted kernel affinity away from the decode-optimized path — leads to small kernels that thrash KV layout.

dave: plausible. I can try a quick tweak: if decode_queue_len > 1 prefer decode-optimized kernel. Small change, should be low-risk.

tara: added the microbench command I used: `./bench --flows prefill,decode --seq 1024 --prefill-budget 48 --decode-budget 8 --kv-warmup 1`

jen: in my repro enabling KV prefetch for decode helped: `kv.prefetch.enabled=true` and `kv.prefetch.window=16` dropped misses by ~30% locally. worth testing in canary.

mike: another angle — batch formation. Prefill tends to aggregate wide batches and can saturate GPU, delaying decode batches. Could cap prefill token-batch to 4096 or add a decode-priority lane.

anita: agree. Also propose a soft token cap: when decode queue depth > 0, throttle prefill to 50% of normal batch tokens (non-blocking). That reduces steal without reverting split.

perf-bot: current canary config excerpt: 
```
{ "queues": { "prefill": { "token_budget": 48, "max_batch_tokens": 8192 }, "decode": { "token_budget": 8, "max_batch_tokens": 2048 } }, "kernel_tiebreak": "small-kernel-for-prefill", "kv": { "prefetch": false } }
```

tara: Plan: (1) dave lands kernel affinity tweak (prefer decode kernel when decode queue>1), (2) enable `kv.prefetch` for decode-only on canary-2, (3) enforce soft prefill cap when decode backlog >0, (4) run 1h microbench + traces. If tail improves we'll promote.

dave: I'll open a tiny PR with the affinity conditional + unit perf test. target: EOD.

mike: If we still see regression after those, revert the split and try token-shaping (allow prefill steal but with diminishing returns). Keep the rollback plan ready. :thumbsup:

tara: thanks — assigning follow-ups: dave (kernel tweak, PR), jen (kv-prefetch canary), anita (add soft-cap logic), mike (rollback plan). I'll collect traces and post results here in ~1.5h.

perf-bot: note: please attach `perf_snapshot.tar.gz` after the next run for full flamegraphs.
